summary: Frontend-only test of the 5 backlog items (iter49) with Playwright on the preview URL. Everything requested works: Rendimiento 'Por estrategia' (7 crypto / 6 FX rows with toggles, '—' cells, 'N de M activas' header, toggle off/on + toast, row dimmed), AI 'Descartar cambios' (source card + provider change, badge, toast, nothing saved after reload), Bybit Avanzado alert input (180 + label), no exchange-error-banner in PAPER, Optimizer confirm dialog (Case B: apply BTCUSDT -> dialog with correct title, Cancel = nothing runs, Confirm = runs + toast 'Revalidación walk-forward completada'; Case A with 0 applied pairs runs directly with no dialog), FX Filtros fix text 16:00–16:30, docs open in both bots, crypto docs mention 'Bybit deja de responder más de 180 s'.
